{ff 00 00 03}New Year's Eve Countdown{ff 00 00 00}{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

messages.en:
{07 16 00}The thing about me is,{01 01 00} {07 15 00}the
more everyone around me
gets all hyped up,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}the less enthused I become.
That might seem cold, {01 00 00 0a 00}
but really, it's just cool.
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Minuga on nii,{01 01 00} {07 15 00}et mida
rohkem kõik mu ümber
elevile lähevad,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}seda külmemaks mina jään.
See võib tunduda külm, {01 00 00 0a 00}
aga tegelikult on see lahe.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}So, you say you're planning

something too, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.

{07 00 00}Nii et sa ütled, et

messages.en:
{07 15 00}I use it as an opportunity
to get rid of excess stuff
like gifts from exes.
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}It's part of cleansing and
starting fresh. Two birds,
one stone, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

et vabaneda kraamist
nagu ekside kingid.
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}See on osa puhastusest ja
uuest algusest. Kaks lindu
ühe kiviga, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 14 00}As a customer, it's a lot of

messages.et:
